MATHIEU FUNCTIONS (p.726)
[Figure 20.3, not fully transcribed: plot of the odd periodic Mathieu functions se_1..se_5 vs z=0-90 degrees at q=1, axes se_r (vertical, -1.0 to 1.2) and z (horizontal, 0-90 deg); se_1 is the smooth monotonic curve reaching ~1.0 at 90 deg, se_2..se_5 are oscillating curves peaking near 1.0 and crossing into negative territory before 90 deg.]
FIGURE 20.3. Odd Periodic Mathieu Functions, Orders 1-5  q=1.
[Figure 20.4, not fully transcribed: plot of the even periodic Mathieu functions ce_0..ce_5 vs z=0-90 degrees at q=10, axes ce_r (vertical, -1.0 to 1.6) and z (horizontal, 0-90 deg); ce_0 is the smooth monotonic curve reaching ~1.4 at 90 deg, ce_1..ce_5 are oscillating curves of decreasing period as order increases.]
FIGURE 20.4. Even Periodic Mathieu Functions, Orders 0-5  q=10.
[Figure 20.5, not fully transcribed: plot of the odd periodic Mathieu functions se_1..se_5 vs z=0-90 degrees at q=10, axes se_r (vertical, -1.0 to 1.6) and z (horizontal, 0-90 deg); same qualitative shape family as Figure 20.3 but with q=10 instead of q=1, so more oscillations packed into the same 0-90 deg range.]
FIGURE 20.5. Odd Periodic Mathieu Functions, Orders 1-5  q=10.
For coefficients associated with above functions
20.2.29  A_0^0(0)=2^{-1/2};\ A_r^r(0)=B_r^r(0)=1,\ r>0
A_{2s}^0=[(-1)^s q^s/s!\,s!\,2^{2s-1}]A_0^0+\ldots,\ s>0
\genfrac{}{}{0pt}{}{A_{r+2s}^r}{B_{r+2s}^r}=[(-1)^s r!\,q^s/4^s(r+s)!\,s!]\,C_r^r+\ldots \qquad rs>0,\ C_r^r=A_r^r\text{ or }B_r^r
A_{r-2s}^r\text{ or }B_{r-2s}^r=\dfrac{(r-s-1)!}{s!(r-1)!}\dfrac{q^s}{4^s}C_r^r+\ldots
Asymptotic Expansion for Characteristic Values, q>>1
Let w=2r+1, q=w^4\varphi, \varphi real.  Then
20.2.30  a_r\sim b_{r+1}\sim-2q+2w\sqrt q-\dfrac{w^2+1}{8}-\dfrac{\big(w+\frac3w\big)}{2^7\sqrt\varphi}-\dfrac{d_1}{2^{12}\varphi}-\dfrac{d_2}{2^{17}\varphi^{3/2}}-\dfrac{d_3}{2^{20}\varphi^2}-\dfrac{d_4}{2^{25}\varphi^{5/2}}-\ldots
where
d_1=5+\dfrac{34}{w^2}+\dfrac{9}{w^4}
d_2=\dfrac{33}{w}+\dfrac{410}{w^3}+\dfrac{405}{w^5}
